blockers.finding: Round-2 BLOCKER 1 is not consistently closed. The resource-allocation interpretation is reasonably grounded by the documented budget, co-benefit, scale, and prioritization constraints, but multiple live fields in the adopted artifact chain still state that a mismatched or wind-confound placement produces no effect. That contradicts both the revised framing and research.md's location-local effects for shade and water-retentive pavement. The simulator header's assertion that every downstream document was reworded is therefore false.

failure_codes.finding: Live CORE/D/outcome fields retain categorical 「効果が出ない／効果が出なかった」 claims even though the revised model expressly says those countermeasures may have physical local effects and only fail the one-deployment priority mission. This unresolved contradiction makes the causal and outcome contract unsafe for game_spec.
